item.title: Knowles Defends Sunfish Junior National Title in Exuma
item.description: EXUMA, BAHAMAS – Drake Knowles is back on top of Bahamian junior sailing, successfully defending his title at the 2026 Bahamas Sunfish Junior National Championship in Exuma.

item.title: The Lure of Bollywood & Bubbles
item.description: NASSAU, BAHAMAS- The fifth annual Bahamas Culinary & Arts Festival’s Bollywood & Bubbles Brunch delivered plenty of color, flavor and share-worthy moments at the Rosewood Ballroom.

item.title: Court of Appeal Orders Retrial For Man Accused Of Killing Ex’s New Boyfriend
item.description: NASSAU, BAHAMAS – The court of appeal has ordered a retrial for Franco Ferguson, quashing his murder conviction and 35-year prison sentence. His lawyers challenged inadequate jury directions on self-defense.

item.title: Water interruption scheduled for eastern New Providence on Thursday
item.description: The Water and Sewerage Corporation says customers in Fox Hill and Yamacraw will have no water from 9am to 4pm on Thursday while crews carry out a water main repair. Residents are advised to store water.
